_note: Patreon英語版（エステ）。キーは日本語版と同じ。{{doc}}=first name, {{docFull}}=full name, {{pat}}=customer. Non-sexual intro lines only.
setup: {{pat}}, an office worker plagued by stiff shoulders and sleepless nights, drops into a small beauty salon on his way home. His therapist is {{docFull}}, a calm and beautiful esthetician.

early: Nice to meet you. I'm {{doc}}, your therapist.
late: I saved the last slot for you again.
Your shoulders are way better now, you know.

early: You've got dark circles under your eyes.
You work at a desk all day, right?
late: Are you eating properly? I worry about you.
You can drop the formalities with me.

early: Between us... today's oil is the fancy one.
Keep it a secret. My manager would be mad.
I don't tell other customers this, but...
I'll book you the same time next week.
late: Hey... can we talk after closing?
Are you free on your next day off?
I found a nice place nearby. Want to go?

early: Nervous? Your shoulders are rock hard.
It's hard to work when you stare like that.
late: Today I might be the nervous one.

early: It's a little cold, so bear with me.
Lavender or citrus, which scent do you like?
late: I already know your favorite scent, {{pat}}.
Can I pick the scent today?

early: Could you fill out this counseling sheet?
How often do you exercise per week?
late: There's more and more I can't write in your chart.
I always put you in the last slot, {{pat}}.

early: Okay, face down on the bed.
Customers who don't listen are a handful.
late: Don't look up at me like that.

early: It's so hot after the sauna...
I'll take my uniform off for a bit.
late: Out of uniform, I'm not staff anymore.

early: This is the staff room, you know.
late: You're the only one I'd show this to.
I told you, no knocking needed today.
It's embarrassing, but I don't hate it.

early: When should I book your next visit?
Make sure you come back. Promise.
late: You can visit me even without a booking.
Hey... what do you think of me?
I can't keep my guard up around you, {{pat}}.

early: Mind if I close my eyes between bookings?
I've been on my feet since morning...
late: Will you stay with me until I wake up?

early: I love the sky at this hour.
late: Want to meet somewhere outside the salon?
Once your shoulders are fixed, you'll stop coming, right?

early: Wow, it's really tight right here.
late: Maybe today it's my turn to get a massage.
Too close? I'm doing it on purpose.

early: Feeling dizzy from the heat? Lie down.
Do you like your omelet sweet?
late: I made a lunch for you too, {{pat}}.
Want me to make you one every day?

early: Shirt off, please. I'll work on your back.
Oh, you're more toned than I thought.
late: Today it's my turn to be shy.

early: My shoulders... I fix everyone else's but mine.
late: Finally, just the two of us.

afterword.text: And then, we had SO much sex.
